item.title: Dara’s ‘Bangaranga’ Wins Eurovision 2026 for Bulgaria
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our special episode, where we're celebrating the excitement of the Eurovision Song Contest. I'm your host, and I'll be guiding you through the highlights of this year's grand final.
[Music transitions to a lively tune]
Host: The big winner of the night was Bulgaria's Dara, who took out the top spot with their high-energy electronic anthem "Bangaranga". This song infused with Bulgarian folk influences had the crowd going wild, and it's no surprise it became one of the breakout performances of the competition.
[Short music clip of "Bangaranga" plays]
Host: Dara's commanding staging and viral live performance propelled Bulgaria to a historic win, ending years of near misses and withdrawals from the contest. Israel came in second, and Romania took third place. The results were determined by a combined vote from national juries and viewers across 35 participating countries.
[Music transitions to a softer melody]
Host: One of the night's most celebrated performances came from Australia's Delta Goodrem, who finished fourth with her powerful ballad "Eclipse". Her cinematic staging transformed the stage into a stunning gold sunscape, reflecting the song's themes of transformation and strength.
[Short music clip of "Eclipse" plays]
Host: Delta Goodrem wore a custom couture gown adorned with over 7,000 Swarovski crystals, and her performance was truly unforgettable. She said, "Representing Australia on the Eurovision stage has been unforgettable, and I'm grateful for all the love and support from home and around the world."
[Music transitions to an upbeat tune]
Host: And the excitement doesn't stop there. Delta Goodrem's Eurovision campaign is just the beginning of a new chapter in her career. She's announced her upcoming eighth studio album, "Pure", set for release on November 6th. We can't wait to hear more from this talented artist.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for tonight's special episode. If you missed the grand final, you can catch it on SBS and SBS On Demand on Sunday at 7:30 pm. Thanks for joining us, and we'll see you next time!
